summary: I checked 30 frame strips at 8 fps plus 12/24 fps crops of the dialogue faces, the kick and Noah's walk-in. Silhouettes are clean and readable, the rim-lit rig holds up at every scale, and camera push/drift/spin moves are eased. The motion itself falls far short of the Ifverse bar. One render bug causes the biggest failures. engine/render.js injects window.VO = {dur, spk, env}, but render.html calls buildTimeline(BEATS, window.VO_DUR || {}), so the timeline never sees real VO durations or speakers. Every line is a 2.5 s placeholder spoken by 'NAR', c.speak('ELI'/'NOA'/'TEA') always returns 0, and no character's mouth moves on any of the 34 dialogue lines (verified on S009, S010, S017, S083, S099). The mixer then places the real mp3s at the placeholder starts, so 35 VO lines overlap and every 'on:'-anchored shot cut is out of sync with its line. Beyond that, heads are frozen in close-ups: no head bob or tilt while talking, and headTilt exists in rig.js but no shot uses it (it would only rotate the face anyway). Breathing is about 1% and invisible. Many actions switch poses with ternaries and no blend, so poses pop on S020, S016, S036, S037, S038 and S066 and the expressions on S009/S014 jump. There is almost no anticipation or settle and very little smear: the S013 kick misses the ball by a mile, then the fall lands and freezes dead for 1.5 s. Walk cycles skate at roughly 2× in S098, S103 and S053, and S006 walks in place. The robot 'race' shots S072 and S095 have no sense of speed. Compared to the reference, with its head tilts, leaning gestures and reaching arms, the characters read as posed paper dolls.
strengths: Silhouettes and wardrobe colour read instantly at every scale; rim light gives clean shape separation.
Camera moves are eased (inOut / out / sine) and every shot has some drift; the S007 hero spin-in settles nicely.
S013 wind-up → swing → fall uses a real arc and pivot, and the fall pose is a clear, funny silhouette.
S034 time-lapse (clock spinning, practice bar filling, grade tint shifting) communicates time compression clearly.
S037 rep counter with the trajectory tightening each rep is a good motion idea; S058/S072 already use the ghosts() helper.
Blink and breathing exist in the rig, and the easing library (outBack, outElastic) is already there to use.

issues.problem: No lip sync anywhere. render.html passes window.VO_DUR (undefined) to buildTimeline, but render.js sets window.VO. All lines become NAR at 2.5 s, so c.speak(SPK[who]) returns 0 and mouths stay shut through every character line. The same bug places real VO at the wrong starts: 35 lines overlap in the mix, and shots anchored with on:'Lxxx' cut at the wrong moment.
issues.fix: engine/render.html: window.TL = buildTimeline(BEATS, window.VO || {}). speakAmp already reads window.VO.env, so mouths then follow the real amplitude envelope. Re-render timeline + video and verify that timeline.json lines show ELI/NOA/TEA speakers with real durations.

issues.problem: Heads are dead still in close-ups. There is no head bob or tilt while talking and no idle sway, so a 3–6 s CU is a frozen image. headTilt exists in rig.js but no shot uses it, and it only rotates the face group, not the head.
issues.fix: rig.js character(): compute talkAmp = o.talk, then apply headTilt = (o.headTilt||0) + 2.5*noise1(t*1.3+seed) + 4*talkAmp*Math.sin(t*7) and headBob = -3*talkAmp*|sin(t*7)|. Rotate the whole head + cap + face + glasses group about the neck point, not just the face. Also add a slow torso sway: lean += 1.5*noise1(t*.5+seed).

issues.problem: Teleport: at about 1.5 s Eli snaps from sitting-writing to P.facepalm(). That pose has no sit:true, so he pops to standing at the desk for a frame range, then snaps back.
issues.fix: act1.js S020: use mixPose(P.sitWrite(c.T), {...P.facepalm(), sit:true, fl:[88,92], bl:[84,88]}, atE(c,1.3,1.6,'outBack')), and blend back out over 1.0 s → 0.25 s. Better still, add P.sitFacepalm to rig.js.

issues.problem: The kick happens about 150 px short of the ball, so it reads as kicking air rather than a near miss. Anticipation is only a straight blend, and impact is 5 frames with no smear. The fall lands with no impact squash or bounce, the ball barely rolls, then Eli is frozen for 1.5 s with no dazed life.
issues.fix: act1.js S013: put the ball at x≈980 so the foot whiffs just over it. Keys: stand → kickWind over 0–0.45 s (ease 'out', plus 4 frames of extra lean-back), kick at 0.45–0.55 s with ghosts() on the leg, trip 0.55–0.75 s. Body rot overshoots -85° then settles to -75° (outBack). Add a 6-frame screen shake on landing (shake: shake(c.t,8)) and a dust puff. Ball: rolls 300 px with ease-out after a tiny nudge from the wind. Hold the fall pose 12–16 frames, then add a small leg twitch and a shock blink.

issues.problem: Football poses are hard ternary switches (ph<.2 ? kick : stand; k<.5 kickWind : k<.9 kick : cheer; reach → facepalm), so the leg and arms pop every rep and the celebration pops in on one frame. In S036 the ball passes in front of the shin with no visible contact or reaction.
issues.fix: act2.js: replace each ternary with poseAt(c.t, [[0,P.stand()],[.12,P.kickWind()],[.2,P.kick(),'out'],[.45,P.stand(),'inOut']]) per rep (use ph for S037). S038: kickWind 0–0.45, kick 0.45–0.6 ('out'), a follow-through hold to 0.9, then cheer at 0.9–1.15 with 'outBack', and hold the cheer with a 2-frame bounce. S036: time the ball's bounce peak to the shin at x≈900, add a recoil to the leg (fl hip −20° for 4 frames) and a 'flinch' head drop.

issues.problem: Key emotional beat: the screwdriver teleports from Noah's hand to the floor or bench when k ≥ .98. The arm lowers at constant pace with no weight. The push-in is linear ('lin'), and the hold has no breathing or eye movement.
issues.fix: act3.js S066: hand the screwdriver off at the hand's world position (character(...).handF) and keep it there, then ease it to the bench over 6 frames with a 2-frame settle rotate (4° → 0°) on the click. Use E.inOut on k with a 6-frame pause before the release (hesitation). Add a slow head drop (headDrop 0 → 8) and one slow blink after placement. Use CAM.push(..., 'sine').

issues.problem: The robot 'races smooth and fast', but the camera is locked to it and the floor is a flat rect with no markings, so it looks parked. Ghost trails at 0.25 opacity barely show. In S095 the robot stops dead on the finish with its wheels still spinning (wheelRot keeps running).
issues.fix: act3.js S072: add floor stripes or table seams every 160 px in the mid layer (they scroll at camera speed), a blurred foreground post layer at fp 1.6 that whips past, horizontal speed lines behind the robot (3–5 lines, 120–300 px, op .5), and a 2 px vertical chassis jitter (noise1(t*30)). S095: drive the robot through the line with E.out and ~40 px of overshoot, settle with a 3-frame nose-dip (rot 3° → 0), and tie wheelRot to dx rather than c.t.

issues.problem: Feet slide because the walk-cycle rate isn't tied to ground speed. In S098 the stride covers about 405 px per cycle at 1.2 cycles/s (486 px/s) while x moves 219 px/s. In S103 the cycle covers 86 px/s while x moves 174 px/s, so the characters skate. The S053 extras move about 2× faster than their cycle. In S016 Noah enters on an ease-out (peak speed about 3× the stride), then pops from walk to sit at 1.2 s.
issues.fix: Add stride-locked walks: walkX(x0, dist, t, h) returns x and phase, with phase = (x - x0) / (190 * h/300). Drive P.walk(phase) from the actual displacement, using linear x inside the walk and easing only on start and stop steps. S016: blend walk → sit over 0.35 s with a little 'drop onto bench' (drop + 6, then settle with outBack).

issues.problem: Eli and Noah walk in place (x fixed at 930/980). At h=60 they are also too tiny to read as walking at all.
issues.fix: act1.js S006: move them with stride-locked x (lerp 760 → 1060 over the shot), or drop the walkers and let the title carry the shot. If kept, use h ≥ 110.

issues.problem: The obsession object swaps (cube → chessboard → book → circuit) are 1-frame hard pops, and Eli's arms vanish behind the book. Eli is frozen front-on with arms out and nothing else changing, so the 'obsession' doesn't read in motion.
issues.fix: act2.js obsession(): on each swap, scale the outgoing object 1 → 0.6 with 3 smear ghosts and a whoosh-arc, and the incoming one 0.6 → 1.08 → 1 (outBack, 6 frames). Give Eli a different 'working' pose per object (cube twist with fa/ba elbows oscillating at 6 Hz, chess reach, book page-turn, soldering lean), increasing lean and headDrop across k, and add a head micro-shake for intensity.

issues.problem: 'Blurring speed' doesn't read. P.controller(c.T*3) is a ±3° wiggle and the ghosts are nearly identical copies, so Eli looks almost still. Noah reading is also static.
issues.fix: act3.js S058: use P.sitType(c.T*4) or a new P.typeFast with ±25° forearm swings at 12 Hz. Render ghosts only for the arms, at 4 copies with dt .025 and op .35, and add a few speed-tick marks around the hands. Give Noah a slow page turn every 1.2 s and a head nod, so the contrast is Eli fast versus Noah slow.

issues.problem: Expressions switch on a single frame with no transition (S009 worried → happy at 0.8 s, S014 flips randomly at 4 Hz, S023 focused → shock, S026 shock static). There is no eye squash/stretch, brow lift or head pop to sell the 'eyes widen' and 'Wait... what?' beats.
issues.fix: rig.js: add an expression transition by drawing a 2-frame blink between expr changes, and add a 'take' helper that scales the head 1 → 1.08 → 1 (outBack, 6 frames) with lookY lift and brows up. Use it on S023 at 0.4 s and on S026 at line start. Hold 'shock' for 12 frames before any change. S014: cycle the wince on note hits (sfx times) instead of hash noise.

issues.problem: Shout and panic beats are static poses. Eli's 'NOAH!' has no lean-in or chest thrust, Noah's 'What?!' stand-up has no rising motion, and the 'LEFT SIDE!' point has no hit.
issues.fix: act3.js: give each a 4-frame anticipation (lean −6, headDrop +4), then the action with outBack (lean +12, arm to pose), then a 10-frame hold with a small vibration (lean ± 1.5 at 18 Hz). S084: animate Noah rising from P.sit to P.shout over 0.4 s. Add shake: shake(c.t,4) for 6 frames on the NOAH! shout.

issues.problem: Crowds are frozen. The S098 foreground cheering extras hold one static P.cheer pose, and in S011 only the y-bob moves, with the laughers' bodies stiff.
issues.fix: Add P.cheerBounce(t) (arms ±15° at 3 Hz, bob 6) with per-extra phase offsets. S011: add lean ±6° and a head-back laugh tilt cycling at 5 Hz, offset per extra.

issues.problem: The reconciliation two-shot has both characters standing rigid through a 5.5 s exchange. There are no listening reactions, gestures or weight shifts, and the S102 shoulder bump must land as a beat.
issues.fix: act3.js S099: once lip sync works, add hand gestures on stressed words (fa to [40, 90] for 8 frames), a weight shift (lean ±3 over 2 s), and listener nods (headDrop 0 → 4 → 0). S102: Noah bump = 4-frame lean-away anticipation, 3-frame contact with Eli displaced 25 px (outBack recovery), then both laugh with head-back tilt.

issues.problem: The callback 'turns to camera' but Eli just stands motionless for 5.7 s with no turn. The comedic hold has nothing to hold against.
issues.fix: act3.js S108: start in 3/4 profile (turn .45), then do a 6-frame snap to front (turn 0 → front, outBack) at line start, followed by a 16-frame bewildered hold with a single slow blink and a tiny eyebrow twitch, then cut.

issues.problem: 'Robot turns cleanly past the barrier' plays as the robot sliding straight down and in front of the barrier, overlapping it. There is no yaw or turn read.
issues.fix: act3.js S093: animate robot rot (0 → −12° → 0) through the turn, scale 1.5 → 1.6 as it comes nearer, and draw the barrier in a fg layer after the robot passes the midpoint so the robot clearly goes around it.

issues.problem: Blink is perfectly periodic (every 3.1 s, same for all characters apart from the seed offset), and breathing at 1.2% is invisible at MS. Idle life reads as mechanical or absent.
issues.fix: rig.js: base blink intervals on hash-driven gaps of 2–4 s with a 3-frame close-squash-open, plus occasional double blinks. Raise breathing to about 2.5% torso scale and add a 1–2 px shoulder rise visible on the arms.
